label: prf:meson-qcg-fusion-identity
title: Proof of meson qcg fusion identity
html:
Proof

Using [n]_q = (q^n - q^{-n})/(q - q^{-1}), multiply both sides by (q - q^{-1})^2 to clear denominators. The identity becomes the ring identity

  (q^3 - q^{-3})(q^4 - q^{-4})
  \;=\;
  (q - q^{-1}) \cdot
  \bigl((q^2 - q^{-2}) + (q^4 - q^{-4}) + (q^6 - q^{-6})\bigr),

which holds in any field with q \ne 0 by direct expansion. \square
heading: Proof
